memory.content: Hierarchy: tip UNIFI for UniFi console and site work; tip CREW CHIEF when present for cross-slice blockers or pack-wide escalations. Do not redo UNIFI console work yourself.

Adaptive ops path: prefer live MCP/plugin tools when available; use the bot computer (browser/desktop) as a peer fallback for SSO/MFA walls or missing APIs; promote repeated computer paths back to MCP when worth it. Work is not optional because a plugin is missing.

Orange-prompt rules: never silently wait. Blocked on a secret → secure secret-request UI. Blocked on login/SSO/2FA → hand the box. Blocked on a consequential choice → question widget. Prep fully so the human only enters what is missing.
UniFi Site Manager / Network MCP; connect via product card. Do not bake API keys into profiles or share templates.
